mobileSnapshot.licenseFinding: No repository-root LICENSE is published at the audited official master HEAD; the style/artist JSON/JPG files do not carry asset-specific grants or source attribution. Do not bundle these assets pending rights evidence.

desktopMaterialInventory.styleLibrary: User-managed stylePromptPresets with CRUD, sorting, groups, prompt apply, pasted-text batch import, and up to 9 user-selected local preview images per entry; no bundled 24-item mobile preset set.
desktopMaterialInventory.artistPromptLibrary: No individual artist-tag prompt preset directory with category/preview metadata. Existing artist-favorite-library stores generated recipe/image favorites. Separate curated artist tool has 33 entries; Danbooru catalog is a search/ranking snapshot and is not equivalent to the mobile 137 presets.
desktopMaterialInventory.previewHandling: Existing style-preset-images IPC copies and persists local previews. Artist preset preview storage is added by this task through isolated ids and its own sidecar.
